name: Geitonies-mobile
description: Real-estate board game for phones — 2–10 players, 3D board, online peer-to-peer play. React · TypeScript · three.js · PWA

paragraphs: A real-estate board game for phones — 2 to 10 players, a 3D board, and online play without a server.
features: Full rules engine — rent and colour groups, even building with a limited bank stock, mortgages, jail (3 doubles, fines, cards), Chance / Community Chest, open and sealed auctions, trades with counter-offers, bankruptcy…
Two boards — classic (40 squares, 2–6 players) and a large 56-square board for 7–10 players.

3D board (three.js) — physics-simulated dice, 23 hand-modelled pieces, a small city of buildings around the board, a camera that follows each move, animated coins for every payment, animations with sound for rent, tax,…

Online play, peer-to-peer — one phone hosts, the others join with a 5-letter code or a QR code. Chat, presence, joining a game in progress (as a player or a spectator, the host decides), automatic moves for absent…

Customisable — three city name sets (Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki), move any neighbourhood to another colour group, change prices, rename squares, write your own cards, pick colours, pieces and photos (taken with the…

whatItDoes.text: A real-estate board game for phones — 2 to 10 players, a 3D board, and online play without a server.

requirements.text: It runs entirely in the browser: no app store, no accounts, no backend, no running costs.
